text: Hey... Just a second!
zh: 嘿……等一下！

text: Did you just come out of this... #:THING:#?
zh: 你刚才是从这个……#:玩意儿:#里出来的吗？

text: Yes.
zh: 是的。

text: No.
zh: 不是。

text: I don't know...
zh: 我不知道……

text:
That's interesting.
I gotta discuss that with our magician.
zh:
有意思。
我得跟我们的魔法师说说这事。

text: We both thought that thing to be nothin' more than an eyesore.
zh: 我们俩原本还以为那玩意儿就是个碍眼的摆设。

text: You ain't foolin' me, honey.
zh: 你可骗不了我，亲爱的。

text: If you want to keep it a secret, that'd be fine for me.
zh: 你要是想保密，我也无所谓。

text: I'm busy doin' more important things than talkin' to you anyway!
zh: 反正我还有比跟你聊天更要紧的事要忙！

text: Hit your head or somethin'?
zh: 摔到脑袋了还是怎么的？

text: Don't worry honey, you'll remember sooner or later.
zh: 别担心，亲爱的，你早晚会想起来的。

text: By the way...
zh: 对了……

text:
I haven't seen you before.
Are you new here?
zh:
我以前没见过你。
你是新来的吧？

text: Yeah, I am new here.
zh: 对，我是新来的。

text: No.
zh: 不是。

text: Well then, let me tell you a few things.
zh: 那好，让我给你讲几件事。

text: You are in the #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Old Forest#text.default#, which is west of the capital.
zh: 你现在在#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#古老森林#text.default#，就在王都的西边。

text:
South of here, there's a small camp. 
#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#Balder#text.default# is the chief of those guys.
zh:
南边有一个小营地。
#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#巴尔德#text.default#是那帮家伙的头儿。

text: To the north there's another camp, but it is full of bandits and idiots.
zh: 北边还有一个营地，不过那里全是强盗和蠢货。

text:
East of here a small river is separating us and the capital.
There used to be a #text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#bridge#text.default#, but it broke down a while ago.
zh:
东边有条小河，把我们和王都隔开了。
那里原本有座#text.frames=4##text.color=highlight#桥#text.default#，但前段时间塌了。

text: Well, then I'm sure you're up to speed, honey.
zh: 那我想你都门儿清了，亲爱的。

text: Is there anything else you want to know?
zh: 你还想知道点什么吗？

text: However, if you have any questions let me know.
zh: 不过，有什么问题尽管问我。

text: Who are you?
zh: 你是谁？

text: Is there something to watch out for?
zh: 有什么需要小心的吗？

text: Where can I get better equipment?
zh: 哪里能弄到更好的装备？

text: Do you know about the Champion's Coin?
zh: 你知道冠军硬币吗？

text: That's all, thank you!
zh: 就这些，谢谢！

text: I am #:Leila:#.
zh: 我是#:蕾拉:#。

text: I usually care for the guys in the camp.
zh: 我平时负责照顾营地里的伙计们。

text: There're goblins all around here in the forest.
zh: 这片森林里到处都是哥布林。

text:
But that ain't half as bad as the wasteland.
Orc settled there.
zh:
但比起荒地，这都不算什么。
兽人在那儿安了家。

text: If I were you, I'd avoid the wasteland altogether.
zh: 我要是你，就压根不去荒地。

text: We have a rather strong smith in the camp. He might sell you a thing or two.
zh: 我们营地里有个挺壮实的铁匠。他也许能卖你点东西。

text:
But he ain't here at the moment.
Probably lying drunk under a tree.
zh:
不过他这会儿不在。
八成又喝醉了，躺在哪棵树底下。

text:
Also, there're several caves nearby.
Sometimes, you can find chests with some leftover equipment in there.
zh:
另外，附近有好几个洞穴。
有时候能在里面找到装着别人剩下装备的箱子。

text: Sorry honey, never heard of that.
zh: 抱歉，亲爱的，没听说过。

text: Try asking Balder or our magician in the camp.
zh: 去问问巴尔德，或者营地里的魔法师吧。

text: Sure thing!
zh: 没问题！

text: Make sure to stay alive for a while.
zh: 可得多活些日子啊。

text: We could use a few more men in the camp.
zh: 营地里正缺人手呢。

text: Do you need something else?
zh: 你还需要什么吗？
